subject: Discovery recap + engagement setup for ClearSky Retail trial
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Morris <tim.morris@clearskyretail.com>, Laura Chen <laura@clearskyretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery call — recap + proposed next steps

Hi Tim / Laura —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before we kick off the trial engagement. I’ve attached a rough scope doc and a draft SOW for the pilot.

Key pain points you shared
- Rising per-request inference cost as traffic scales (especially for the summarization flow)
- p95 latency spikes during peak hours impacting UX (target: <200ms p95)
- Model drift / inconsistent answers on product FAQs after catalog churn

Primary goals for the 30-day engagement
1) Validate that we can reduce cost per completed summary by ~35–45% relative to your current setup (service-level baseline: $0.012/summary).
2) Achieve p95 latency < 200ms for summary endpoint under typical peak load (simulated at 120 QPS).
3) Measure quality parity on a curated prompt set (start: 120 prompts across categories).

Proposed scope (high level)
- Two API endpoints: Summarization (user-facing) and Reranking (search results).
- Evaluation: weekly automated evals on the 120-prompt set + two human review passes (start and end).
- Traffic: synthetic load tests up to 120 QPS; limited real-user traffic (canary 5% after baseline verification).

Owners & roles
- Technical lead (Redwood): Monica Patel — will handle environment setup and run initial integration tests.
- Customer technical lead: Tim Morris — will provide API keys, dataset access, and help validate metrics.

Immediate next steps
1) Tim: share API key scoped for testing + service account for GCS access (needed for prompt/eval artifacts) by EOD Wed (12/02).
2) Monica/Priyom: provision trial account, spin up staging endpoints, and run baseline performance tests (target: by Fri 12/04).
3) Agree on final SOW and sign (I attached the draft — please comment inline).

Attachments: clearsky-pilot-scope-v1.docx, redwood-pilot-sow-draft.pdf

If that all looks right I’ll schedule the technical kickoff for Thursday at 10am PT (30–45 mins) — propose calendar invite once Tim confirms the API key delivery timing.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199

From: Tim Morris <tim.morris@clearskyretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@clearskyretail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery call — recap + proposed next steps

Thanks for the thorough recap, Priyom — this matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side:
- The $0.012/summary baseline you called out is the current blended cost across our stack. Good to confirm target reduction relative to that.
- For dataset access: we can provide a read-only GCS bucket with anonymized past queries + product metadata; I’ll coordinate with infra to provision the service account.
- Human review: we have two product managers (Laura and me) who can do the review passes; if we need more, we’ll loop in CS.

Two asks before kickoff:
1) Can you add an explicit success criterion for quality (e.g., >0.85 avg score on the 120-prompt evaluation or no more than 10% drop vs current)?
2) Proposed timing: we prefer kickoff on Thu 12/03 at 11am PT — does that work for you?

Also, I’ll upload a short doc with sample anonymized queries to the Drive link you shared by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Tim
Head of Search & Personalization | ClearSky Retail

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Morris <tim.morris@clearskyretail.com>, Laura Chen <laura@clearskyretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery call — recap + proposed next steps

Tim — perfect, updated below with the explicit success criteria and a short technical kickoff agenda. I’ve also included the concrete access/setup checklist we’ll need to begin.

Success criteria (agreed)
- Cost: >= 35% reduction in average cost per completed summary vs baseline ($0.012) measured on end-to-end traffic during the trial window.
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for summarization endpoint under verified 120 QPS synthetic load.
- Quality: Automated eval score >= 0.85 on the 120-prompt set AND human review pass where product owners flag no more than 10% of outputs as unacceptable.

Technical kickoff agenda (30–45 min)
1) Introductions & roles (5 min)
2) Walkthrough of integration plan: endpoints, auth, and metrics (10 min)
3) Access checklist & data flow (10 min)
4) Baseline performance validation plan & KPIs (10 min)
5) Risks, fallbacks, and next milestones (5–10 min)

Access/setup checklist (what we need from ClearSky by 12/02 EOD)
- Read-only GCS bucket access (service account with limited scope) + example files (anonymized queries).
- API key for a sandbox instance of your product (or a backpack proxy) so we can simulate end-to-end traffic.
- A small sample of labeled outputs (50 examples) for quick local quality checks.
- Contact for infra & security (for any network whitelisting or IP allowlisting).

Timeline & milestones
- Day 0 (Kickoff Thu 12/03): confirm access, provision trial endpoints.
- Days 1–3: baseline run and synthetic load tests; initial automated eval.
- Week 1: tuning and quantization recommendations; mid-week human review.
- Week 2–3: continuous testing, quality monitoring, and canary 5% real traffic if metrics hold.
- Week 4: final evaluation, cost/latency report, and recommendations to production roll.

Owner contacts
- Redwood technical: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Slack: @monica_p
- Redwood AE: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
- ClearSky: Tim Morris <tim.morris@clearskyretail.com>, Laura Chen <laura@clearskyretail.com>

Related links
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CLRSKY-2026-0118
- Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dPilotAssets

I’ll send the calendar invite for Thu 12/03 11am PT and attach the kickoff agenda. We’ll also circulate the editable SOW for Tim/Laura to mark up.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Priyom

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Morris <tim.morris@clearskyretail.com>, Laura Chen <laura@clearskyretail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery call — recap + proposed next steps

Quick internal note — I’ve reserved a staging pool for the trial (2 x A10G nodes, autoscale policy disabled for initial baseline). I’ll post invitation to the internal kickoff channel and start the baseline scripts once Tim confirms GCS access.

If we need larger capacity for load runs, I’ll coordinate procurement but we should be fine for the first week.

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
